notes: Official Violet inference images. Validators compare miner-declared digests against allowed_digests.
Populate allowed_digests with sha256:... values when images are pinned for a release.
Strict mode (default VIOLET_REQUIRE_IMAGE_DIGESTS=1) rejects blank, :latest/mutable tags, and unknown digests.
Set VIOLET_REQUIRE_IMAGE_DIGESTS=0 only for local bootstrap / CI with mock images.
